import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int dest;
        int cap;
        int flow;
        int rev;
        Edge(int d, int c, int f, int r) {
            dest = d;
            cap = c;
            flow = f;
            rev = r;
        }
    }

    static final int MAX_N = 11;
    static final int INF = 1000000000;
    static final int MAX_NODES = 2 * MAX_N * MAX_N;

    static List<Edge>[] adj = new List[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] level = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] ptr = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int src, dst, gridN;
    static Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
    static Queue<int[]> q_bfs = new LinkedList<>();
    static final int[] dx = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static final int[] dy = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int[][][][] dist = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N][MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int time_threshold;
    static char[][] matA = new char[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static char[][] matB = new char[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[] forbidden = new int[2];

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int c) {
        adj[u].add(new Edge(v, c, 0, adj[v].size()));
        adj[v].add(new Edge(u, 0, 0, adj[u].size() - 1));
    }

    static boolean bfs_levels() {
        Arrays.fill(level, INF);
        level[src] = 0;
        q.add(src);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                int v = e.dest;
                int rc = e.cap - e.flow;
                if (level[v] == INF && rc > 0) {
                    level[v] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.add(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[dst] != INF;
    }

    static int dfs_flow(int u, int flow) {
        if (u == dst) return flow;
        for (; ptr[u] < adj[u].size(); ptr[u]++) {
            Edge e = adj[u].get(ptr[u]);
            int v = e.dest;
            int rc = e.cap - e.flow;
            if (level[v] == level[u] + 1 && rc > 0) {
                int pushed = dfs_flow(v, Math.min(flow, rc));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    e.flow += pushed;
                    adj[v].get(e.rev).flow -= pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int dinic_maxflow() {
        int result = 0;
        while (bfs_levels()) {
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            int f;
            while ((f = dfs_flow(src, INF)) > 0) {
                result += f;
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    static boolean valid_pos(int[] p) {
        int x = p[0], y = p[1];
        return x >= 0 && x < gridN && y >= 0 && y < gridN && matA[x][y] != 'Y' && matA[x][y] != 'Z';
    }

    static void bfs_fill(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < gridN; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < gridN; ++j)
                dist[sx][sy][i][j] = INF;
        dist[sx][sy][sx][sy] = 0;
        q_bfs.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        while (!q_bfs.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q_bfs.poll();
            if (dist[sx][sy][cur[0]][cur[1]] == dist[forbidden[0]][forbidden[1]][cur[0]][cur[1]] && (forbidden[0] != sx || forbidden[1] != sy)) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int[] nxt = {cur[0] + dx[k], cur[1] + dy[k]};
                if (valid_pos(nxt) && dist[sx][sy][nxt[0]][nxt[1]] == INF && dist[sx][sy][cur[0]][cur[1]] + 1 <= dist[forbidden[0]][forbidden[1]][nxt[0]][nxt[1]]) {
                    dist[sx][sy][nxt[0]][nxt[1]] = dist[sx][sy][cur[0]][cur[1]] + 1;
                    q_bfs.add(nxt);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        gridN = sc.nextInt();
        time_threshold = sc.nextInt();
        int px = -1, py = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < gridN; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < gridN; ++j) {
                matA[i][j] = sc.next().charAt(0);
                if (matA[i][j] == 'Z') { px = i; py = j; }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < gridN; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < gridN; ++j)
                matB[i][j] = sc.next().charAt(0);
        forbidden[0] = px;
        forbidden[1] = py;
        bfs_fill(px, py);
        for (int i = 0; i < gridN; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < gridN; ++j)
                dist[forbidden[0]][forbidden[1]][i][j] = Math.min(dist[forbidden[0]][forbidden[1]][i][j], time_threshold);
        for (int i = 0; i < gridN; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < gridN; ++j)
                if (valid_pos(new int[]{i, j})) bfs_fill(i, j);
        src = 0;
        dst = 2 * gridN * gridN + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_NODES; ++i)
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < gridN; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < gridN; ++j) {
                if (matA[i][j] != '0') {
                    add_edge(src, i * gridN + j + 1, matA[i][j] - '0');
                }
                if (matB[i][j] != '0') {
                    add_edge(i * gridN + j + 1 + gridN * gridN, dst, matB[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < gridN; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < gridN; ++j) {
                for (int i1 = 0; i1 < gridN; ++i1) {
                    for (int j1 = 0; j1 < gridN; ++j1) {
                        if (valid_pos(new int[]{i, j}) && valid_pos(new int[]{i1, j1}) && dist[i][j][i1][j1] <= dist[px][py][i1][j1]) {
                            add_edge(i * gridN + j + 1, i1 * gridN + j1 + 1 + gridN * gridN, INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(dinic_maxflow());
    }
}
